title: AI Engineer
highlights: Building RTCOM, DESIGO's operating system for traceable milk: Plant, Farm and Fleet (rider) apps, a customer app, Muster attendance and a Supabase ERP, serving ~2,100 customers with 30+ riders.
Face-recognition attendance (Muster) with layered anti-spoofing — passive liveness, device detection and head-movement challenges — in use for staff check-in.
Computer-vision R&D: a Milkofit pipeline that locates and reads all 16 reaction pads of a milk-adulteration test card, and a crew dress/PPE check (helmet, jacket, gloves, shoes).
